evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched grammatical frame ('a rollback we…') set in deliberate opposition — unrehearsed vs. not-actually-have — crystallizing a rule through contrast.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the rule here crystallized as matched opposed clauses rather than stated as a plain imperative?
